description: This file declares functions, includes, and structures related to handling HTTP chunked data processing in the server.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_mem
methods.description: Copies memory data into the request's HTTP chunk buffer.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends a buffer to the request's HTTP chunk buffer; may reset the buffer.

methods.name: http_chunk_decode_append_mem
methods.description: Decodes and appends memory data to the request's HTTP chunk data.

methods.name: http_chunk_decode_append_buffer
methods.description: Decodes and appends a buffer to the request's HTTP chunk data; may reset the buffer.

methods.name: http_chunk_transfer_cqlen
methods.description: Transfers a specified length of chunk queue data.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_fd
methods.description: Appends a file descriptor's content as a chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_ref
methods.description: Appends a referenced file's metadata as a chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_fd_range
methods.description: Appends a range of a file descriptor's data as a chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_ref_range
methods.description: Appends a range of a referenced file's data as a chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_close
methods.description: Closes or finalizes the HTTP chunk processing for the request.
